{{Quote|Beautiful, aren't they? They're Corellian flame miniatures, one of that very short list of art forms which others have tried to copy but never truly been able to duplicate.|Thrawn|<ref name="DFR" />}}
'''Corellian flame miniatures''' were [[light sculpture]]s that resembled glowing, floating flames with a pinkish [[Color/Legends|color]]. They were designed by [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] [[Artist/Legends|artists]]<ref name="DFRCom" /> from transoptical fibers combined from pseudoluminescent plant material and [[Goorlish light source]]s. Those fibers were then shaped into extremely delicate sculptures, each of which took the shape of a luminescent blaze.<ref name="DFR" />

Although simple in design, Corellian flame miniatures were deeply admired and never truly duplicated by any other [[Species/Legends|species]], although several tried to do so. [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] admired this art form, and during his [[Thrawn campaign|military campaign]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], he surrounded himself with dozens of [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] images of them to calm himself as he thought and reflected.<ref name="DFR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The concept of Corellian flame miniatures was created by author [[Timothy Zahn]] and first appeared in ''[[Dark Force Rising]]'', the second in his [[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy|Thrawn Trilogy]] series of novels.<ref name="DFR" /> They were later featured in a single panel of the [[Dark Force Rising 3|third issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Star Wars: Dark Force Rising (comic series)|adaptation of ''Dark Force Rising'']] by [[Mike Baron]]. There they were illustrated for the first time by penciller [[Terry Dodson]], inker [[Kevin Nowlan]] and colorist [[Pamela Rambo]].<ref name="DFRCom" />
